name: Cloudflare composition: local evidence foundation
description: Reuses all eleven sandbox save/reopen and blueprint round-trip checks, then exercises the real read-only provider operations view with fictional scope, coverage, dependency and cost observations. It establishes local contracts, not live Cloudflare capability.

evidence.note: No committed baseline is attached to this pack. Retain each source-pinned local output separately; fixture results do not establish completed Cloudflare journeys.

limits: A local pass covers the named source functions and fictional observations only; it is not a browser, deployed application or live Cloudflare check.
Provider operations are derived from supplied observations. No account is contacted, and no actual resource permissions, provisioning or preview isolation are established.
Only observed service/D1/R2/KV bindings are represented. Queues, Workflows, external clients and unread Worker settings remain outside the known dependency graph.
This pack does not measure model quality, production latency, upload throughput, provider charges, data restoration or completion of the Cloudflare wishlist.
The zero-spend requirement prohibits provider execution here; it does not turn unknown cloud resource charges into zero costs or grant retirement authority.
Run this optional pack explicitly through the existing runner; its separate directory does not add a blanket check to routine releases.
